title: Copilot Studio: Review panel shows agent readiness and policy blocks while building
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and Microsoft's documented Review experiences and guidance controls. The corrected Maker guidance path and sign-in example are supported, and the page distinguishes preview controls and unpublished Review-specific pricing from harness consumption billing.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Connector blocking is reached through Power Platform admin center > Security > Data and privacy > Data policy > policy > Edit Policy > Next > Next > connector > three dots > Block.
claims.quote: On the sidebar, select Security, and then select Data and privacy. ... Select Data policy. ... select the data policy and select Edit Policy. ... Select Next. ... Select Next. ... Select the three dots ... next to the connector ... select Block.

claims.claim: Get-DlpPolicy -PolicyName <policy name> is a documented Microsoft.PowerApps.Administration.PowerShell command.
claims.quote: Module: Microsoft.PowerApps.Administration.PowerShell Module. Get-DlpPolicy [-PolicyName <String>] [-ApiVersion <String>]

claims.claim: Data policies govern Copilot Studio agents in the environments covered by the policy.
claims.quote: These data policies apply to Copilot Studio agents in the environments included in the policy's scope.

claims.claim: Get-DlpPolicy reads policies rather than blocking a connector.
claims.quote: Retrieves a list of DLP policy objects. ... The Get-DlpPolicy cmdlet retrieves policy objects for the logged in admin's tenant.

claims.claim: No admin UI is documented for configuring the tenant-wide DLP error contact email and Learn more link.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Platform DLP error settings admin contact email Learn more links user interface New-PowerAppDlpErrorSettings. Opened Configure data policies for agents; search also returned PowerShell support for Power Apps and Power Automate. Both document PowerShell, not a UI.

claims.claim: New-PowerAppDlpErrorSettings -TenantId "<tenant ID>" -ErrorSettings $ErrorSettingsObj configures the DLP error contact email and Learn more link.
claims.quote: To add the email address and "Learn more" link, run the following PowerShell script. ... New-PowerAppDlpErrorSettings -TenantId "<tenant ID>" -ErrorSettings $ErrorSettingsObj

claims.claim: Set-PowerAppDlpErrorSettings updates an existing configuration.
claims.quote: To update an existing configuration, use the same PowerShell script, but replace New-PowerAppDlpErrorSettings with Set-PowerAppDlpErrorSettings.

claims.where: controls[4].ui and api; Why it matters; Governance controls; Open questions

claims.where: What's changing; Scope; title; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Review gives makers building Microsoft Copilot harness agents a single view of readiness, governance and security issues.
claims.quote: As you build an agent powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness, the Review entry point gives you a single place to see issues that affect your agent's readiness, governance, and security.

claims.claim: Review surfaces restrictions caused by data policies and Advanced Connector Policies.
claims.quote: It surfaces problems caused by data policies, Advanced Connector Policies, and other organizational controls, so you can find and resolve them before they block publishing.

claims.claim: The Review icon appears in the top menu bar.
claims.quote: The Review icon appears in the top menu bar.

claims.claim: The Review icon shows the number of outstanding issues.
claims.quote: the icon shows the number of outstanding issues.

claims.where: What's changing; summary; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Blocking issues prevent publishing the agent.
claims.quote: Blocking | Issues that prevent you from publishing the agent

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Warnings do not stop publishing.
claims.quote: Warnings don't stop publishing, but review them to understand how they might affect your agent.

claims.claim: Warnings may affect agent behaviour or compliance.
claims.quote: Warning | Issues that don't block publishing but might affect the agent's behavior or compliance

claims.claim: Review can report a data policy blocking a tool, connector or knowledge source the agent uses.
claims.quote: A data policy blocks a tool, connector, or knowledge source your agent uses.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Review can surface an issue that sign-in is not required, so anyone with the link can use the agent.
claims.quote: The Review panel can surface issues such as: ... Sign-in isn't required, so anyone with the link can use the agent.

claims.claim: Review can surface that no channel is configured.
claims.quote: No channel is configured, so people need another entry point to use the agent once it's published.

claims.claim: Review can surface use of an experimental or preview model.
claims.quote: The agent uses an experimental or preview model, which hasn't completed full testing.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Each issue has a call to action, such as Update settings or Contact admin, taking the maker to where it can be resolved.
claims.quote: Each issue shows a short title, a one-line explanation, and a call to action, such as Update settings or Contact admin, that takes you to where you can resolve it.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; controls[0].governs; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: A tool, connector, AI model or skill blocked by data policy or Advanced Connector Policy appears disabled wherever it would normally be selected.
claims.quote: When a data policy or Advanced Connector Policy blocks a tool, connector, AI model, or skill, that item appears disabled wherever you'd normally select it, such as the tools list, model list, or skills list.

claims.claim: Hovering over the cross icon next to a disabled item explains why it is blocked.
claims.quote: Hover over the cross icon next to the disabled item to see why it's blocked.

claims.claim: Makers can see a connector restriction and its reason before configuring it.
claims.quote: Makers can hover over the unavailable capability to view information about why it's restricted. Because the capability can't be selected, makers can identify the policy restriction before configuring it in their agent.

claims.claim: For standard-harness agents the Agent status summary appears on the Overview page.
claims.quote: This article describes features used in agents or agent flows powered by the standard harness. ... The Agent status summary appears on the overview page for an agent, under the Copilot details card.

claims.claim: Selecting Review in the standard-harness Agent status summary opens the issues.
claims.quote: When you select Review in the Agent status summary, you see agent issues grouped by severity:

claims.claim: The standard-harness Agent status documentation is marked prerelease and subject to change.

claims.claim: Agents built with the standard harness remain fully supported alongside Microsoft Copilot harness agents.
claims.quote: Agents built with the standard harness remain fully supported alongside agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance controls; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Review reports issues rather than replacing admin-level governance or compliance reporting.
claims.quote: The Review panel doesn't replace admin-level governance or compliance reporting. Some detailed diagnostics might still be available in other experiences, such as the Power Platform admin center.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No new data access is documented for the Review feature itself.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio Review readiness data access autonomous. Opened both Review articles and read the roadmap description; they describe configuration and policy issue reporting, not new data access.

claims.claim: No autonomous behaviour is described for Review itself.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio Review readiness data access autonomous. Opened both Review articles and read the roadmap description; they describe maker-facing issues and calls to action, not autonomous Review actions.

claims.where: summary; Risk assessment: Change & support; controls[1].governs
claims.claim: Configured policy-error contact guidance appears with blocked items and in Review; otherwise a default message appears.
claims.quote: If your organization configured a contact or help link for policy-related errors, that guidance appears alongside blocked items and in the Review panel. If your organization hasn't configured this guidance, a default message appears instead.

claims.claim: The Review Learn page lists no licence for the panel itself.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio Review readiness price license meter. Opened Review agent readiness and status in Microsoft Copilot Studio (Microsoft Copilot) in full; it has a harness billing note but names no panel licence.

claims.claim: The Review Learn page describes no meter for the panel itself, separately from harness billing.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio Review readiness price license meter. Opened both Review articles and Overview of usage-based billing; the former names harness consumption but specifies no separate Review-panel meter.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a separate Review price at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio Review readiness price license meter. Opened both Review articles, harness overview and Overview of usage-based billing; no separate Review price was specified.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn names no specific role for configuring these guidance settings at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: maker guidelines role administrator; maker guidance role; authoring-agent-status role guidance. Opened Configure maker guidelines and Review agent readiness and issue status; both refer to admins without naming a required security role for these settings.

claims.claim: The standard-harness page describes previously allowed resources later being blocked by a new policy.
claims.quote: If a resource (such as a knowledge source) was previously allowed but later blocked by a new policy, Agent status indicates which state (draft, published, or both) is affected.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not document how Maker guidelines and Maker guidance interact when both are configured.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio maker guidance maker guidelines relationship. Opened Configure maker guidelines and Review agent readiness and issue status; each documents its own setting without explaining interaction between the two.

claims.claim: Custom guidance messages are not localised.
claims.quote: Custom guidance messages aren't localized. The message appears exactly as configured, regardless of users' language settings.

claims.claim: For custom guidance, an environment-group message overrides the environment-level message.
claims.quote: The environment group message overrides the environment-level message.
